instructions: Regenerate or upgrade useful mechanisms using the complete consolidated history and current outcomes, not a fresh unrelated shortlist. Publication novelty is not required. Include DeepInfer PRs, issues and pinned implementation. The main scope is existing two TP1/DP4/EP4 H200 replicas with Marlin, seq64, DSpark k5, adaptive verification off. Respect C03 failed promotion and C01 external grouped hold; no repeat service attempt without a new mechanism/evidence and explicit reopening reason. C24 baseline timing work is concurrent and its verdict is pending: do not duplicate it or infer results. New ideas may evolve existing families; distinguish research/pilot readiness from full experiment readiness. Every card needs conditional optimization delta or explicit unknown, engineering-hour and GPU-hour budgets, bounded pilot and correctness tests with stop/proceed/inconclusive rules. Use literal evidence; upstream SM100/EP64 gains cannot be H200 EP4 predictions. Do not launch GPU, model generation serving traffic, benchmarks or deployment. Existing artifact analysis, CPU checks, research model calls and software tests are in scope.
